monument.A1: The welcome wall shows your face and the word WELCOME. Stand in the road until a colleague notices you.
monument.B1: Battery 1 is fitted. Staff watch from the podium bridge; you join the road and dash into a colleague.
monument.C1: The drum warns every colleague of each bend. Step off the high road onto a car; gravity is company policy.
monument.C2: The raised road runs through this tower. Take the final hit up there, and Certification comes closer.
monument.B2: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS, a target. Walk or stand beside it until a colleague finds you.
monument.A2: The neon shops flash prices at the traffic. Hands 1 is fitted: place a cone, and let a colleague react.
monument.A3: Each cube rests on the one before. Chain your hits the same way; the last link writes you off.
monument.B3: Legs 1 is fitted. The screens advertise to each other; jump into a car between them.
monument.C3: Under the gateway, your file reads ROLE: DESTRUCTIVE TESTING. Let one colleague throw you into the next.

parkland.C1: The lantern is lit for the Expo's clients. Arms 1 is fitted: push off one car into the next.
parkland.C2: On opening day, our board will watch from these terraces. A van delivers the catering; let it deliver you.
parkland.C3: The arch is the Expo's gate. Clients enter when the park passes; chain each hit to the last.
parkland.B3: On opening day, police escort a school party to the obelisk. Take a police car's hit first.
parkland.A3: A wedding is booked on the belvedere. Legs 2 is fitted: jump into a car, so no guest does.
parkland.A2: The dome awaits clients. Hands 2 is fitted: lay a cone, and let the car that reacts write you off.
parkland.A1: Arms 2 is fitted. Teach the cars to stop before the reservoir: push off one, into the next.
parkland.B1: The cascade steps down beside the highway. Climb to the raised road; a write-off there serves our clients.
parkland.B2: Battery 2 is fitted. The board watches the ring; end a long chain on a car for our clients.

waterfront.A1: At the west portal, buses carry engineers to the bridge. We need the bus fleet's data; meet the bus.
waterfront.B1: Legs 3 is fitted: the longest flight. Jump at a car by the tunnel portal; your data serves our clients.
waterfront.C1: The police check papers at the east portal. Take your final hit from a police car; your papers follow.
waterfront.C2: Beyond the rail, ships wait to carry Certified dummies to clients. Drop onto a car below.
waterfront.C3: The customs post logs every dummy shipped to our clients. Be thrown into a car, and earn your entry.
waterfront.B3: Show Chassis 0 how far the model has come. Arms 3 is fitted: push off one car into the next.
waterfront.A3: Your customs entry reads DECLARED VALUE ONE UNIT · PURPOSE DESTRUCTION. Honour the declaration on the raised road.
waterfront.A2: Sand on the west beach terrace came from three provinces. Place a cone; the car that reacts writes you off.
waterfront.B2: The monument is cast from every write-off. Battery 3 is fitted: finish the chain and ship Certified.

acts.monument: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; Certification is your goal.
acts.parkland: The Expo opens to clients when this park passes. Your training keeps them safe.
acts.waterfront: Certified dummies ship across the river, to be sacrificed in service to our clients. Your papers are being prepared.

any.label: ANY WRITE-OFF
any.brief: General coverage. Any write-off in this tile counts.

dash.label: DASH INTO A CAR
dash.brief: Coverage gap: dashes. The final hit must be a dash into a car.

drop.label: DROP ONTO A CAR
drop.brief: Coverage gap: falls. The final hit must be a drop onto a car from above.

jump.label: JUMP INTO A CAR
jump.brief: Coverage gap: jumps. The final hit must be a jump into a car.

level.label: ON A RAISED ROAD
level.brief: Coverage gap: raised roads. The final hit must land at Z1 or above.

cone.label: CONE-BAITED CAR
cone.brief: Coverage gap: cones. The final hit must come from a car reacting to a cone.

push.label: PUSH OFF A CAR
push.brief: Coverage gap: ricochets. Push off one car; the final hit must be the next car.

bounce.label: THROWN INTO A CAR
bounce.brief: Coverage gap: rebounds. The final hit must come while a hit is still throwing you.

struck.label: STRUCK, NOT DASHING
struck.brief: Coverage gap: pedestrians. The final hit must be a car hitting you while you walk or stand.

combo.label: COMBO ×{n}
combo.brief: Coverage gap: chains. The final hit must be link {n} or later of a combo.

cls.label: A {cls}
cls.brief: Coverage gap: the {clsLong}. The final hit must come from a {cls}.

ending: Your model has passed and will be manufactured for our clients. A Corporation drone carries you to the ship.

notices.n01: You are a Dummy Corporation trainee. Every write-off brings Certification closer.
notices.n02: Welcome, trainee. Every write-off brings Certification closer.
notices.n03: Shenzhen Smart City, tile by tile. Each tile trains you to its brief.
notices.n13: A Corporation drone brings this part.
notices.n14: A Corporation drone brings this part. Keep training.
notices.n15: A Corporation drone brings that part
notices.n17: Corporation drone dispatched: chassis in the river
notices.n18: Corporation drone dispatched. Obstruction will be relocated.
notices.n19: Corporation drone: chassis recovered from the river
notices.n20: Training complete. The Corporation thanks you for your service.
notices.n21: Traffic exhausted. Training incomplete; report to the bay.
notices.n24: Neon shops, LED walls; one road splits round the monument under the walkway ring. Your training begins here.
notices.n25: Water and concrete; a boulevard passes under the raised ring. Your write-offs open the Expo to clients.
notices.n26: A hill walled by towers; bridges cross the drive and the river. Certified dummies ship across it to clients.

b013.text: OI! Right in the grille, kind regards.

b034.text: A write-off on my record. Unthinkable.

b052.text: Too slow, ha! Have a nice day!

b061.text: It lunged and nothing happened. Same.

b081.text: Move. I have a schedule, and standards.

c024.text: Hit on campus. That goes on my record.
